alignments.note: The conjunction takes the causal connective the ASV writes for it.
Participial predicate rendered as a light verb with its complement; head on the complement under rule 44. Discontinuous around the subject under rule 25.
Divine name; explicit subject takes only its own English.
Construct noun keeps only its own word.
Suffix rendered by the possessive, rule 18.
Finite verb with its English subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb.
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the *the* the ASV supplies to make it a noun phrase under rule 46, headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
